lines: Divine Touch: +2% chance for divine azurite; Each chisel hit on a plain azurite vein outside the mist has a chance to turn it divine, with the same lightning as a heavenly strike. Any chisel works, in any biome.

Ascendant Rune: +10% chance that a property added by a rune rises one tier; When a rune adds or raises a property, it has a chance to rise one tier more as a separate step, beyond the item's level limit. You see a second flash, hear a chime and read "+1 affix tier".
Perfect Inscription: +10% chance that a property rolled by a rune takes the highest value of its tier; A property rolled by a rune (Fate included) has a chance to take the highest value of its tier.
new.name: Ore Hauler

lines: Runecarver mastery: Reserved: this profession is not designed yet.
old.name: Ore Hauler

lines: Armour effectiveness increases the armour value used to mitigate incoming hits without increasing the displayed armour rating. It does not increase armour-derived damage or other bonuses based on armour.
new.name: Armour effectiveness

lines: A boss essence ascends a weapon, shield or summoning staff to the biome after its boss. Base damage (in the item's own damage types), durability and block rise to that biome's weapons of the same kind - nothing goes down; a summoning staff's minion becomes as strong as that biome's creatures. Workbench upgrades start over at quality 1 and then cost what that biome's weapon costs. Properties, sockets, sigils and implicits stay. One essence per item, and only upward. Rings and belts can also ascend: only their item level rises, unlocking higher property tiers on future rolls. Their current properties, implicit effects, base stats and quality remain unchanged.
new.name: Ascension

lines: A boss essence ascends a weapon, shield or summoning staff to the biome after its boss. Base damage (in the item's own damage types), durability and block rise to that biome's weapons of the same kind - nothing goes down; a summoning staff's minion becomes as strong as that biome's creatures. Workbench upgrades start over at quality 1 and then cost what that biome's weapon costs. Properties, sockets, sigils and implicits stay. One essence per item, and only upward.
old.name: Ascension

lines: The waiting time before an ability can trigger again. It is separate from loading a crossbow magazine.
new.name: Ability cooldown

lines: Bow and crossbow shots deal full damage up to their effective range. Beyond it, damage first decreases gradually, then falls more steeply to a fifth at the far limit. Increased effective range stretches the entire curve.
new.name: Effective Range

lines: Bow and crossbow shots deal full damage only up to their effective range, a little beyond melee distance. Further away the damage falls off with the distance to the target, down to a fifth at five times that distance. Increased effective range moves both distances further out.
old.name: Effective Range

lines: Evasion rating gives a chance to avoid an attack or spell hit completely, capped at 150% before decay; each successful evasion multiplies the chance against every attacker by 80%, resetting after 8 without an eligible incoming hit. The cost ranges from 4% to 18% of maximum stamina according to the damage that would reach health after blocking, resistances, armour, endurance and rune shields, compared with maximum health; evasion cost reductions and a chance to spend no stamina apply. Damage-over-time ticks cannot be evaded, and a successful passive evasion triggers on-evade effects and interrupts stamina regeneration unless an effect prevents this; a manual dodge roll is a separate action.
new.name: Evasion rating

lines: Evasion rating grants a chance to avoid a hit completely, including its damage, stagger, knockback and ailment. The chance weighs evasion rating against the attacker's accuracy and reaches 100% at 3 times the accuracy. Each evasion against the same attacker leaves 80% of the chance against it, until it lands no attack for 8 (30 for a boss). Each evasion costs 18% of maximum stamina; without that stamina the hit lands. Damage over time, persistent damaging ground and environmental damage cannot be evaded; a successful passive evasion triggers on evade, independently of a manual dodge roll. Passive evasions interrupt stamina regeneration unless an effect explicitly prevents this.
old.name: Evasion rating

lines: Per point: 0.185% increased stamina regeneration, 0.15% increased evasion rating. Dexterity also contributes to the skill multiplier of the weapons it governs.
new.name: Dexterity

lines: Per point: 0.185% increased stamina regeneration, 0.2% increased evasion rating. Dexterity also contributes to the skill multiplier of the weapons it governs.
old.name: Dexterity

lines: Fists include both unarmed attacks and fist weapons such as claws. Fist bonuses apply to both; unarmed bonuses apply only without a weapon.
new.name: Fists

lines: Fist weapons and unarmed attacks share fist bonuses. Unarmed bonuses require empty hands; unarmed attacks count as dual-wield without a shield and one-handed with a shield.
old.name: Fists

lines: Reload fills the magazine of Crossbows. Additional projectile chance rolls at successful reload completion. Reload speed shortens the reload; crossbow fire rate controls the interval between loaded shots. Cancelling a reload does not grant loaded shots.
new.name: Crossbow reload

lines: Reload fills the magazine of Crossbows. Additional projectile chance rolls at successful reload completion. Reload speed shortens the reload; crossbow fire rate controls the interval between loaded shots. Cancelling a reload does not grant loaded shots.
old.name: Reload

lines: An area attack against the ground using blunt damage as its basis. Damage converted into blunt contributes and elemental conversion from that basis remains effective; raw non-blunt damage, slashing and piercing cannot be dealt by a slam. Sledges’ ground attacks and alternatives turned into slams gain slam bonuses and aftershocks, are not strikes and never split damage between targets.
new.name: Slam

lines: An attack that hits the ground in an area and deals only blunt damage: the area attacks of sledges and similar weapons, and alternative attacks that a mastery turns into a slam. Slam bonuses and aftershocks apply to these hits. A slam is not a strike and never splits its damage between targets.
old.name: Slam

lines: Unarmed attacks use empty hands, without a fist weapon. They also count as fists; without a shield they count as dual-wield, and with a shield as one-handed.
